name: Wideframe
long_description:
Wideframe is an AI coworker for video editors. It automates the searching, labeling, organizing, and sequencing of footage so editors can ship videos faster.

Why is this important? Well, it turns out that editors spend 3x more time preparing footage than actually editing.

One agency said we will save their editors 10 hours per week. Another organized an entire documentary worth of footage in hours rather than weeks. He had 2,500+ videos, 500+ audio clips, across >2.5 TB of files and our agent handled them effortlessly.

Users link footage to Wideframe and then our Agent acts like an Assistant Editor to handle work like searching, labeling, organizing, and sequencing footage. Wideframe works with footage across local filesystems and cloud providers. We also supports Adobe Premiere Pro (.prproj) roundtrip. Our robust integrations are important so that Wideframe can work with source footage all the way through to delivering Premiere Pro projects to editors.
one_liner: AI coworker for video editors to ship more video faster

launches.body:
Hey everyone 👋

We’re [Daniel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/danielvpearson/) and [Zack](https://www.linkedin.com/in/heyzk/), the co-founders of [Wideframe](http://try.wideframe.com?source=yc).

**TL;DR**

**Wideframe is an AI agent that speeds up the 75% of video work that happens outside the Non-Linear Editor. It helps teams save time and do more with their videos.**

Users link their video libraries to Wideframe and then work with our context-aware agent to tackle search, editing, and generative tasks. Our high-performance desktop app works across the filesystem and can even natively handle Adobe Premiere Pro (.prproj) files in and out.

**User Testimonials**

_“Wideframe will save each of our editors 2 hours per day. They will have more time to focus on the quality of their work and doing more without the stress.”_

* Matthew Gattozzi, Founder at Goodo Studios

“OH MY GOD YOU ARE A FREAKING GENIUS”

* A user after Wideframe automatically watched, renamed and organized 24 videos in 3 minutes

**Ask**

**Try Wideframe free for 7 days: [try.wideframe.com](https://try.wideframe.com)**

**Interested in custom video agents? Reach out: [daniel@wideframe.com](mailto:daniel@wideframe.com).** We’ve built custom workflows for clients already and are excited to build more! 

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z9ws9Mj4XZQ>

**Our Story**

Zack has been an engineering leader for 20+ years. Daniel managed $1B+ in ads for tech companies. We are ex-coworkers and have been close friends for 15 years.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97978&key=user_uploads/3180583/d458cf74-8cd2-47ed-9fd3-ae6bf10358d6)

**Making pasta in Rome between Claude Code sessions.**

Throughout 2025, we developed an ever-increasing obsession with coding agents. 

By late 2025, we committed to bringing the power of coding agents to Daniel’s growth world in the form of agentic video editing. Our original YC pitch was “Claude Code for Video Editing”. 

In our first 75 days since launch, we’ve onboarded more than 50 brands and agencies. Many of them make tens or hundreds of videos per week for ads or organic social. What we discovered while building for them: **75% of their video work happens outside of the NLE.**

Our clients prefer to finish their videos in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. They don’t want an “agentic NLE”. And they don’t spend a lot of time using the NLE in the first place. 

They spend 4-5x more time each week doing research, writing briefs, searching for videos, scrubbing _within_ videos, organizing sequences of a-roll and b-roll, producing rough drafts, getting feedback from their team and/or clients, and now generating content to augment their footage as well.

We’re delivering real value within these workflows and our ambition is to become the default workspace where people and agents can collaborate to get the most out of their video.

**How Wideframe Works**

**Wideframe is an AI agent that speeds up the 75% of video work that happens outside the Non-Linear Editor. It helps teams save time and do more with their videos.**

Users link their video libraries to Wideframe and then work with our context-aware agent to tackle search, editing, and generative tasks. Our high-performance app lives on the machine and works seamlessly across the filesystem and can even natively handle Adobe Premiere Pro (.prproj) files in and out.

Wideframe is a coding style agent that lives on your machine with built-in tools and skills for frame-accurate video understanding, agentic search, sequencing, storytelling, research, and context-aware image, video, and audio generation.

**Interested in custom video agents? Reach out: [daniel@wideframe.com](mailto:daniel@wideframe.com).** We’ve built custom workflows for clients already and are excited to build more!
